headline: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents to monitor AI agents
body: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents, a feature intended to monitor the AI agents a company uses. TechCrunch reports that Nadella warned, in a blog post, that “we need to separate the supply of intelligence from the authority over it.”
note: For banks running agents, the open question is who watches the agent. Nadella warned against trusting AI model providers to do that job.

evidence.text: Microsoft on Monday introduced new security features designed to protect enterprises from the growing threat of AI agents.
Guardian Agents , a new feature intended to monitor the AI agents a company uses.
Earlier this month, in his private blog , Nadella warned that it’s time to stop trusting AI model providers, even if they offer assurances of safety and security with their agentic products.
In other words, we need to separate the supply of intelligence from the authority over it.
